F-R46-1.measurement: tie pixel (7/16, 10/16, 0), level 128/255: pigment lum (binary32 blend_math::lum) 0x3f000000 = cut (level - 0.5/255) 0x3f000000 -> white. GPU lum bracketed by stepping the level bits so the kernel's own binary32 cut walks 0x3efffffb..0x3f000002: Vulkan white at cut 0x3effffff, black at 0x3f000000 -> GPU lum = 0x3effffff; DX12 white at 0x3f000000, black at 0x3f000001 -> GPU lum = 0x3f000000. 1110 8-bit real-arithmetic ties (30R + 59G + 11B = 12750): Vulkan 49, DX12 76 decided unlike pigment (pigment white 1030).
F-R46-1.cause: contraction into FMA (evidence, exact rational model fma-model-smb-r46-followups-1.py/.txt in the lane artifact folder): full contraction fma(0.11, b, fma(0.3, r, round(0.59 g))) reproduces Vulkan's 0x3effffff and its 49 exactly; fma(0.11, b, fma(0.59, g, round(0.3 r))) reproduces DX12's 0x3f000000 and its 76; none of the other four modelled evaluation orders (plain sum, one fused product with the second sum rounded, fma over the rounded first sum) matches either backend. naga 27.0.3 emits no NoContraction decoration (grep of back/spv). Which driver stage fuses is vendor behaviour: UNVERIFIED (D5).
F-R46-1.fix: kernel.wgsl threshold_lum: each product plus the runtime zero ext.adj[0].y (ext.rs writes params[0] = [level, 0, 0, 0] for Threshold), then ((p0 + p1) + p2): no product feeds a sum; a contracted fma(w, c, 0) rounds w c once like the plain product. Pigment unchanged, no golden changed, no tolerance touched. After: 0 of 1110 on both backends, tie lum 0x3f000000 on both.
F-R46-1.removed: THRESHOLD_TIE_WINDOW, threshold_tie, threshold_cut, gpu_vs_reference_ties and the NOT_PROVEN boundary line (66c62129); ext_adjustment_layer_parity compares the 7 lattice ties exactly again (gpu_vs_reference_with). threshold_tie_at_the_cut_is_either_side_and_off_tie_pixels_match renamed threshold_tie_at_the_cut_and_off_tie_pixels_match_pigment (its claim changed: the tie must be white as pigment; the 1e-4 below/above greys kept).

verdicts.claim_scope: Engine lane under D6 closing R46 F-R46-1..7 and R45 F-R45-1..3 at its brief: render-gpu threshold luminance without FMA contraction (runtime zero ext.adj[0].y added to each product, ((p0+p1)+p2)), the 2^-20 tie exemption and its NOT_PROVEN line removed, exact parity at the 7 lattice ties and the 1110 8-bit ties; FXC tests run an explicit DX12 row on the test-only TransientAdapter::dx12_for_tests (test-faults) before the platform row; test-faults grant-closure hook (GrantClosure, inject_closure, GpuBackend::inject_grant_closure) proving execute / execute_grade refuse a closed held grant with no device work; report_port tested for all 17 PortEvents; shared-device overflow flag written after authorize; GrantLedger bounded (live records only, tombstones, open count; live_records()); observe RingRecord::host_core_le_bytes (host DiagEvent core with the projected event_code) + DESCRIPTOR; interop-fig-base GRID track and sizing lists over 1000 refused before entry work, cancellable per entry, HashSet / id index; harness-view design auto-layout Geo walk memoised, depth-continuous, charged against MAX_SUBTREE (no egui code); harness export-sequence --audio count cap 16, 1 GiB per audio file, one 4 147 200 000-byte decoded budget (transient-peak gap disclosed); composite three refusal tests pin (layer_id, feature). Out of scope: F-R46-8 (harness dev-dependency, with the GUI lane), F-R46-12

rows.1 no egui / toolkit type, no new egui co: PASS: 0 added lines of the 2055-line claim diff name egui, eframe or winit (validator grep of validator-R47/patches/r46-followups-1.patch); harness-view's only change is the Geo walk in view/design/auto_layout.rs (an egui file: egui only in auto_layout_ui, field and choice, :862-:994; Geo uses no toolkit type) plus a #[cfg(test)] module; new public render-gpu items (GrantClosure, GpuClientPort::inject_closure, GrantLedger::inject_closure/live_records, GpuBackend::with_grant_and_shader_source/inject_grant_closure, TransientAdapter::dx12_for_tests, SharedDevice::overflow_flag_writes) carry plain data (GpuGrant, enum, usize, u64, DeviceOptions, AdmissionRequest, Arc<dyn GpuClientPort>, &str), all but live_records behind test-faults; wgpu appears only in the test host of client_port.rs (test code)
rows.2 no new GPU device/instance/queue/pool/: PASS: TransientAdapter::dx12_for_tests pins the existing transient adapter's candidate list to [Dx12] (test-faults; the asset-local stand-in D3 sanctions until MT-203); the grant-closure hook closes grants through the existing ledgers; the overflow-flag write moved behind authorize (no new queue); the new shared-device test opens a test-host wgpu device like the existing shared-device tests (test code, not product)
rows.3 controls registry: PASS with finding (not applicable to the registry): no new command or control id; the export-sequence command gains two refusal codes (audio_too_many, audio_too_large) and three bounds that its manual entry (harness-core manual.rs:27) does not list (F-R47-2; harness-core was outside the brief's owned paths)
rows.4 actor: PASS: no new mutating op; GPU admission, ledger closure and CLI bounds are not document mutations; no default_actor() or literal actor in added lines (validator grep)
rows.5 observe, no text: PASS: GrantLedger tombstones are closed u8 codes; report_port now has a caller in tests and emits one Terminal frame of port_outcome_of(event) with no event code text (report_port_emits_one_terminal_frame_per_port_event, 17 events); RingRecord::host_core_le_bytes projects the core's event_code onto the host DiagEventCode allowlist (Other at 292d7a1c); new CLI outcomes are typed JSON refusals; nothing writes text into observe
rows.6 jobs: PASS with finding: no new queue, worker or job; the --audio decodes are bounded before allocation by count (16), per-file bytes (1 GiB) and one retained budget (4 147 200 000 bytes), but one decode's transient peak is bounded only by reel's 8-channel cap times the import frame bound (F-R47-1, HBR-HOST-004)
